name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: AI Agent Builder & Customer-Facing Operator | Onboarding, Activation & Product Feedback
summary: Operator who designs and ships AI agents and automated workflows, with 15+ years in SaaS onboarding, account management, and go-to-market. Breaks manual workflows into agent architectures with custom logic, builds evaluation rubrics to grade agent output, and writes Python and JavaScript in automation code steps. Onboarded 25+ customers a month at Wix and fed structured customer feedback to Product and Engineering at Birdeye, and thinks about product surfaces from first login onward, for both people and agents.

Translate non-technical stakeholders' loosely formed ideas into precise prompts and agent instructions, bridging business intent and reliable LLM output.
Built and launched a free digital-footprint audit as a product-led top-of-funnel offer: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients.
